scenario: [LUNI.2.4.1]: a unit literal's value in its base unit is a constant the compiler emits, and in integer storage one outside the 64-bit signed range is refused at the literal with DS_VALIDATE_CONSTANT_OUT_OF_RANGE. `10000000000_s` is 10^19 ns on the `time` dimension, past 2^63 - 1, though the literal's own magnitude fits ([LLEX.11.1.5] admits it). A compiler that wraps emits -8446744073709551616 ns and compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.luni_3_1_7_literal_type`, through `dsc.quantity.luni_2_4_1_literal_out_of_range` and `dsc.exact.luni_2_4_1_int64` over the literal's exact base value; `dsc.quantity.is_whole` judges the value whole, of any size, so DS_VALIDATE_UNIT_LITERAL_NOT_WHOLE does not take it.
rules_ds:
schema Job scope logical:
    id: Int key
    d: Duration mutable

rule long:
    Job j where j.d > 10000000000_s
->
    log info "long"
